description: Does the scheduler split the batch? Counts engine iterations per dispatch at the concurrency levels where e02 found two cost modes. output_len=1 so decode iterations do not bury the prefill iteration that carries the signal.
note_levels: 8 and 16 are unimodal in e02 and act as CONTROLS: the mechanism is only confirmed if cost separates by step count on 9/10/12/14 and does NOT separate on these. Listing them in control_levels is what makes the verdict falsifiable rather than a restatement of 'the metric varies'.
